test: Grainfield sustain and overlap handling is deterministic
command: pulp test -- -R '^Grainfield sustain and overlap handling is deterministic$' --output-on-failure
result: deterministic finite output; event offsets are consumed within one 256-frame process call
scope_note: This validates Grainfield's declared mono/global MIDI policy. The upstream Beads Synth has no MIDI API, so this is adapter-contract evidence rather than source-vs-port MIDI parity.
